answer: The term “Artificial Intelligence” was first used at the Dartmouth Conference in 1956.
ChatGPT reached 100 million users in just **two months**.
The three core components of AI are **Algorithms, Data, and Compute**.
The rough rule of thumb is that **1 token equals about 0.75 words** (i.e., 75 % of a word). Consequently, **100 tokens correspond to roughly 75 words**.
The paper that introduced Transformers is the Google research paper titled **“Attention Is All You Need,”** and it was published in **2017**.
Christie's sold the first AI artwork for **$432,500 (USD)**.
Cisco’s 2023 Annual Internet Report estimates that there are **about 29.3 billion networked devices worldwide**. Of those, **approximately 14.7 billion are Internet‑of‑Things (IoT) devices**.
TSMC holds about **55%** of the market share, while Samsung has roughly **15%** of the market share (as of 2023).

The 2023 Swedish study found that AI‑supported breast‑cancer screening (analysis of mammogram images) performed as well as two radiologists working together, cut the radiologists’ workload by about 50 %, and resulted in roughly 20 % more cancers being detected early for treatment.

The ITU reports that, in 2022, 34 % of the world’s population – about 2.6 billion people – had never been connected to the Internet. In the least‑developed countries, the share of people without Internet access is even higher: 64 % of the population is offline, which is roughly twice the global average of 34 % not online.
IBM Deep Blue beat chess grandmaster Gary Kasparov in 1997.
The researchers nicknamed the “Godfathers of AI” are **Yann LeCun, Geoffrey Hinton, and Yoshua Bengio**.
The 1950 paper by Alan Turing that introduced the Turing Test is **“Computing Machinery and Intelligence.”**
Gordon Moore observed that the number of transistors on an integrated circuit was doubling roughly every two years.
Google’s AI chip developed since 2016 is called the **TPU (Tensor Processing Unit)**.
In 2022 there were roughly **5.75 billion webpages** online. If a person spent **one minute on each page**, it would take about **11,000 years** to study them all (assuming no breaks).
According to the Randstad survey, only **13 % of workers** had been offered any form of AI training in the last 12 months.
Videos related to AI tools received **more than 17 billion views on YouTube in 2023**.
The UK is investing **£900 million** in an exascale computer for AI research.
The two new units of data measurement agreed in 2022 are the **Ronnabyte (RB)** and the **Quettabyte (QB)**.
